title: Excellent bed frame
text: Excellent bed frame. Very easy to put together. Holding up well sleeping on it. Take about 20 minutes to put together.

product_metadata.title: GreenForest Twin Bed Frame Quick Lock Heavy Duty Metal Platform Bed Mattress Foundation, No Screws and No Box Spring Needed
features: Quick and Easy to Assemble: NO SCREWS REQUIRED. Easy to assemble and disassemble, and within 5 mintues to put the twin bed frame together，just use the hammer to fix the frame and put the steel slats snap in the notch, finshed.
Heavy Duty and No Box Spring Needed: bed frame made of reinforced thicker and wider steel slats allow the platform bed frame max loading 990lbs, stable and no shake, and stay away from squeaking.

Customized Design For Headboard and Footboard: In order to improve your using experience, we offer you a special design that the bed frame come with pre drilled holes on the head and foot so that you can easily attach headboard or footboard. Please check your bed frame size before to attach headboard or footboard.

Extra Under Bed Storage：The totally height of this twin size bed frame is 12.5 inch, and offer you 11 inch storage space underneath the bed frame for you to storage the bedsheet, clothes or toys.Keeps your room tidy and clear.
MINIMALIST LOOK:This metal bed frame perfect design and minimalists will be great for teenagers' rooms, guest rooms, dormitories, apartments and short visiting families or friends.

details.Included Components: 1 x Bed Frame with Slats, 1 x Hammer, 1 x Manual
